notes.title: MAGIC WAND STEAM RELEASE
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29317728/d384a8eb88f4a5c6b4f727bfe51c27ba717f595c.gif

Greetings!! If you are viewing this message you are probably able if not willing to hypothetically purchase this game on Steam now, as on itch.io and Gamejolt previously.

There is a launch discount which will be carried over to both those sites shortly along with Steam keys for whoever bought a copy! If not.. this game is like a mini collapsible capsule-toy version of Dragon Quest VII. Wander around a mysterious world of ruins and monster dudes and try to figure out what's going on. Make new friends and lose them again. See the colours and walk around the beach. What was I trying to do? Only the magic wand can answer.

##ENJOY WALKING AROUND AND FALLING OFF THE BLOCKS!! OTHER SITE UPDATES INCOMING SHORTLY!!##
